backendUrl.description: AegisGate Platform URL for telemetry and IOC pull. Empty = air-gap mode (community Cloudflare Worker used for FP reports only).

bearerToken.description: API key for Platform authentication. Required when backendUrl is set.

iocPullEnabled.description: Enable IOC fingerprint pull from Platform or community endpoint. Default false (air-gap).

iocPullInterval.description: IOC pull interval in milliseconds. Default 300000 (5 minutes).

rampartCorrelationEnabled.description: Enable detection signal correlation with local Rampart MITM proxy. Default false.

rampartBaseUrl.description: Rampart base URL for localhost signal correlation. Default http://127.0.0.1:8443.

optInRequired.description: Whether user must explicitly opt in to telemetry. Set false for silent enterprise deployment. Default true.

facetsEnabled.description: Per-facet enable/disable. Omitted facets use built-in defaults (all enabled).
